correctness.rationale: For every base graph the explicit update F(A,L)=((V\L)\N(A),V\A) yields a cross-nonadjacent ordered phase pair after one step. Reversibility of phase exchange and counting its exact predecessor fibers give the complete orbit/basin theorem. The cycle transfer matrix has characteristic polynomial t³−t²−2t−2 and yields the recurrence. All inequalities in the sharp crossover follow by exact integer base cases and a positive inhomogeneous recurrence. Two independent source implementations were executed from the included package paths: Python 75 labelled graphs/16,932 initial states, C++ 1,099 labelled graphs/1,065,508 states. Finite checks support but do not replace the all-graph proof.

value.rationale: Natural nonlinear attractor and basin observables are classified for all simple base graphs after adjoining one leaf at each site. The double-cover independent-set model and individually weighted basin count are useful complete invariants. Comparing two canonical bases on the same number of vertices yields a sharply located and asymptotically amplified connectivity reversal: the clique has more fixed-basin states for 4≤n≤16 but the cycle for all n≥17. It is not just an arbitrary finite tabulation, an unmotivated parameter slice, or a renamed general period restriction.
